pollution_metrics.censoring_semantics: episode-end un-reused admissions are right-censored and excluded from pollution numerator

future_reuse_proxy_metrics.claim_boundary: future-request reuse proxy; not causal eviction regret or oracle gap

type_aware_metrics.dependency_byte_denominator_semantics: sum unique base_model+adapter resident bytes once within each eligible typed request; the same shared base is counted again only for a distinct request event because it is a requested service dependency, never once per lookup row or resident inventory entry
